archiveExp_searchPhoto:
-Enter the full name of the person whose photo you are searching for.
-Click the appropriate result from the list.
>>The photo and parent folder name of the selected record will appear.
-You can modify the selected record using the 'Update Record' button.
-You can delete the selected record using the 'Delete Record' button.
-If the drive containing the record is connected, select the drive and click 'Go to Folder' to open the record folder.
archiveExp_addFolders:
-For this operation, first create a folder and copy the subfolders belonging to the records you want to archive into it.
-These subfolders must be named with the full name of the registered person. (PLEASE DO NOT USE '_' UNDERSCORE IN ANY RECORD OR PARENT FOLDER NAMES!)
-When you search for a subfolder (the record folder for a person), seeing a representative photo helps you recall the record. Name one of that person's photos 'a.jpg' at a low resolution. (If you don't do this, the program will assign the first image found in the person's folder as the Representative Image)
** To use: Select the folder you want to archive with the 'Select Parent Folder' button, then press the 'Add to Archive' button.
archiveExp_makeSpare:
-You can backup all your records in the database using this feature.
** To use: Select the backup location using the 'Select Location' button.
-After selecting the location, start the backup process with the 'Backup' button.
-The duration of this process varies depending on the number of records in your database.
archiveExp_addSpareToArchive:
-Your computer may have been formatted or your database may have been deleted for other reasons.
-Using this feature, you can transfer a previously backed up record to your database.
** To use: Select the backed up folder using the 'Select Backup Folder' button, then press the 'Add to Archive' button.
-The duration of this process varies depending on the number of records in your backup file.
Note: Even if you repeat this process using the same backup file multiple times, your records will only be created once in the archive.
